name: Alex Pereira

official.source: data/derived/fighters.json (76 in height, 79 in reach); 251 lb at the UFC Freedom 250 official weigh-in (2026-06-13, heavyweight debut). His previous fights were at light heavyweight (205 lb).

photo_coverage: Good. 14 photos, 11 of them from 2026; 8 are public-domain or CC BY on Commons (White House, U.S. Army, Interior Department, one CC BY 3.0 video still). Frontal: DOI June 2026 (fight week, shaved) and the ESPN studio headshot (off-camp, curly hair). Three-quarter: Oval Office handshake. Near-profile: Lincoln Memorial June 2026 (left side). Body: two ESPN studio cutouts (2025 lean, 2026 heavyweight) plus the June 2026 weigh-in and octagon photos. No true right-side profile.
two_looks: He has two distinct looks. Fight week and fight night: head shaved to the skin and face shaved to light stubble (a pre-fight ritual; seen June 12-14 2026 and April 2024). Between camps: dense, tightly curly black hair 1.5-4 cm and a full short beard with a little grey. The sheet below is set for fight night (shaved head, stubble); the off-camp values are given alongside.

face.shape: Long, broad face that reads rectangular to oval: widest at the cheekbones and jaw, with only slight taper to the chin. The lower face is heavy and full, more so at heavyweight in 2026. Shaved, the skull is a high, smooth dome, long front to back with a rounded back of the head (Lincoln near-profile).
face.jaw: Wide and strong with well-defined, slightly squared angles set below and in front of the ears. The jawline runs fairly straight into a thick neck; under the off-camp beard it looks even more square.
face.chin: Medium-wide and rounded, moderately projecting (in profile roughly level with the lower lip). No cleft visible.
face.cheekbones: High, broad and prominent at the sides (clear in the DOI frontal), with fleshy mid-cheeks below them.
face.brow_ridge: Strong and heavy. The eyes sit deep under it and look shadowed in most light.
face.forehead: Medium height, broad and fairly upright, with a few faint horizontal creases. When the hair is grown the hairline is straight across with squared corners and only slight recession at the temples.

eyes.shape: Almond-shaped with a narrow vertical opening; heavy, partly hooded upper lids and slightly puffy lower lids, giving a calm, half-lidded look. Outer corners level.
eyes.size: Look small for the face because they are deep-set and hooded.

eyebrows.shape: Fairly straight and low-set, close to the eyes, with the outer thirds angling slightly down. Inner ends sit close together.

nose.width: Broad through the bridge and very broad at the base
nose.bridge: Straight and fairly wide; in the near-profile it runs straight to very faintly convex.
nose.tip: Large, rounded and fleshy, projecting forward; points straight ahead or very slightly down.
nose.fight_damage: None obvious. The bridge is broad but straight and centred in every photo.

mouth.upper_lip: Medium-thin with a defined philtrum and a soft cupid's bow
mouth.resting_expression: Neutral, corners level to slightly down; lips often slightly parted. Rarely smiles in fight-week photos.

ears.protrusion: Stand out moderately from the head, very noticeable when the head is shaved (DOI frontal).
ears.cauliflower_ear: None visible. The left ear (Lincoln near-profile, Oval Office three-quarter) has normal folds; the right ear is only seen frontally and looks normal.

face.notable_marks_scars: No large scars visible. Faint horizontal forehead lines. One or two small dark spots (small moles) on the cheeks next to the nose: on his right cheek in the ESPN headshot and on his left cheek in the Oval Office three-quarter. Visible pores and slightly uneven texture on the cheeks.

hair.style: Fight night: head shaved with clippers to about 1 mm, so the scalp shows a faint dark stubble shadow (DOI and Lincoln 2026-06-12, octagon 2026-06-14, UFC 300 2024). Off-camp: dense, tight curls cut short, about 1.5-2 cm in May 2026 (Oval Office) and about 3-4 cm in the 2026 studio headshot, slightly fuller on top, no part.
hair.colour: Black with a dark brown cast in bright light.
hair.hairline: Straight across with squared corners and mild temple recession (Oval Office, studio headshot). Visible as a faint stubble outline when shaved.
hair.texture: Tightly curly to coily and dense when grown.

facial_hair.detail: Fight night: shaved, leaving light stubble on the chin and upper lip (octagon 2026-06-14) or nearly clean (DOI 2026-06-12). Off-camp: full short beard about 1-2 cm, dense on the chin and moustache, with a natural cheek line at mid-cheek and a low neckline (Oval Office, studio headshot, cowboy-hat photo).
facial_hair.colour: Black-brown; the off-camp beard has scattered grey and white hairs on the chin and along the jaw (studio headshot).
facial_hair.density: Dense on the chin and moustache, slightly lighter on the upper cheeks.
facial_hair.shape: Off-camp: moustache joined to a full chin beard, rounded at the chin; cheek line natural, not sharply lined.

skin.tone_hex_method: Mean of the 7 samples not marked excluded (9x9-pixel medians). The magenta-graded Oval Office samples and the studio forehead highlight are left out.
skin.tone_note: Medium tan skin. The kept average leans light because two samples sit on lit cheeks and two come from the high-key studio shot; the shadow-side DOI cheek and forehead (#ce8c73, #d0916e) are the most neutral, so tone_hex_recommended is set between them and the average.
skin.undertone: Warm golden-olive, with a reddish flush on the nose and cheeks in daylight.
skin.freckles_marks: No freckles. Small moles near the nose (see face). Moderate chest and abdominal hair in the 2026 studio shot (not shaved), dark hair on the forearms and shins.
skin.texture_pick_reason: Chosen only because its swatch (#e8ccb2) is the closest lighter base to the sampled tone, so the multiply tint can reach #d39579 without brightening.

body.build: Tall, long-limbed and heavy-boned. At heavyweight (251 lb, June 2026) he is thick and solid rather than cut; at light heavyweight (2025 studio) he was lean with clear abdominal definition. Reach (79 in) is 3 in longer than his height.
body.body_fat_notes: 2026: smooth midsection, no visible abs, slight lower-belly fullness, fuller chest and face. 2025: lean, clear six-pack.
body.shoulders: Broad with round, full deltoids; moderate trapezius height, so the neck-to-shoulder slope is gentle.
body.chest: Thick and full; at heavyweight the lower pec line is soft.
body.arms: Long and thick, with heavy forearms and big hands. Muscular but not vascular in 2026.
body.waist: Thick and fairly straight-sided at heavyweight, so little V-taper; noticeably narrower in 2025.
body.legs_calves: Long, thick thighs with good quad mass; solid calves. Legs look long relative to the torso.
body.neck: Thick and medium-long; narrower than the jaw.
body.posture: Upright and relaxed, shoulders level, chin level or slightly raised, arms hanging loose. Expressionless stare at the camera in fight-week photos.
body.notable_physique_traits: Height and limb length, a big frame that now carries heavyweight mass around the waist, and extensive colour and black-grey tattoos on the chest, abdomen, both arms and the right thigh.

tattoos.where: Right arm, near-full sleeve from shoulder to wrist
tattoos.description: Several connected pieces: on the outer upper arm a coiled Asian dragon in red, orange and black over black-grey sun-ray stripes (2026); on the front of the upper arm a dark geometric hexagon or shield outline; on the inner forearm a pair of hanging boxing gloves in red-brown; on the outer forearm a black-grey feather. Cursive lettering on the inner upper arm is seen only when flexing (weigh-in) and cannot be read.

tattoos.where: Left forearm (outer side) and back of the left hand
tattoos.description: Black-grey forearm work with small red and teal blocks (2025 studio), plus a back-of-hand piece of rounded stone or cobble shapes in black-grey that runs to the knuckles (DOI 2026, UFC 300, Oval Office).
tattoos.size: Forearm about 20 x 10 cm; hand about 8 x 8 cm

tattoos.where: Left chest and over the top of the left shoulder
tattoos.description: Large black-and-grey Asian dragon: open-mouthed head with whiskers on the left pec facing the sternum, body and a clawed foot curling over the left deltoid.
tattoos.size: About 25 cm tall x 22 cm wide

tattoos.where: Right collarbone and upper right chest
tattoos.description: Dragon tail or flame shape with black outline and red-orange fill, coming from the top of the right deltoid down over the collarbone and ending in a spiky, forked tip pointing at the sternum.

tattoos.where: Upper abdomen, below the pecs (mostly his right side and centre)
tattoos.description: Red and orange Asian dragon with a red pearl, lying horizontally below the pecs (2026 studio and weigh-in). In 2025 only a smaller red-outlined flame or dragon shape sat under the right pec, so this looks like a recent addition or extension.

tattoos.where: Left side of the abdomen and left flank
tattoos.description: Black-grey koi fish swimming upward among peony flowers, from the lower left ribs to the left hip.

tattoos.where: Lower abdomen, just above the waistband, slightly to his right
Right thigh, front, just above the knee
tattoos.description: Black-grey portrait of an Indigenous man in a feather headdress (2026 studio, weigh-in).
Dark oval black-grey design seen only small in the weigh-in photo; the subject cannot be made out.

accessories_seen: Large gold wristwatch on the left wrist (Oval Office, DOI); a gold chain with a 'Poatan' pendant (UFC 300). At the June 2026 weigh-in he wore a feather headdress, red face paint and a tooth necklace (ceremonial, not for the fight model).

kit.typical_shorts: UFC Freedom 250 (June 2026): royal-blue fight shorts with red diagonal stripes on his right hip and a white stars-and-stripes style band low on the right leg with the crypto.com logo, green Monster Energy logo on the front right, UFC on the black waistband; red gloves (studio version labelled 'Freedom'). 2025 (UFC 320 era): Venum multicolour print shorts (red leopard-style spots on one leg, African-style geometric print with blue and yellow on the other) with a black inner panel.
kit.gloves: Standard UFC 4 oz gloves; red at Freedom 250, black in the 2025 studio shot.
kit.walkout: Freedom 250: red, white and blue walkout jersey with crypto.com and a UFC logo, blue shorts, red gloves, blue-white-red sneakers.
kit.brand_note: Venum is the UFC outfitter; logos on the 2025 shorts are Venum.

render_hints.hair: none (shaved for fight night) with a faint dark stubble tint over the scalp; off-camp use a short curly cap tinted #1d1a1a
render_hints.beard: light stubble on chin and upper lip, #2e2321; off-camp a dense short full beard about 1.5 cm

morphs_variant_light_heavyweight._note: Overrides for the lean 205 lb version (2025 studio cutout). Apply on top of 'morphs' if he is shown at light heavyweight; keys set to 0 switch a target off.

morphs_not_in_embed._note: assets/embed/mh-manifest.json has no ear targets. Estimates for standard MakeHuman ear modifiers in case they are added.

notes: Confidence: high for skin tone range, hair and beard states, tattoos and build; medium-high for face proportions (good frontal, three-quarter and left near-profile); low-to-medium for exact morph values. Watch for: (1) Pick one look. Fight night (default here) is a shaved head and light stubble; the curly hair and full beard of the studio headshot and the May 2026 Oval Office photo are the off-camp look. (2) The face is long and broad with high cheekbones, a heavy brow and deep-set, hooded eyes; if the eyes are too open or the brow too light he stops looking like himself. (3) The nose is long with a big rounded tip and wide base, but straight and undamaged; keep it projecting. (4) Ears stand out when the head is shaved. (5) Body: at heavyweight keep the waist thick and the abs smooth; use morphs_variant_light_heavyweight for the lean 205 lb version (fighters.json lists him at light heavyweight). (6) Tattoos are a strong recognition cue: black-grey dragon on the LEFT pec and shoulder, red-orange flame/tail on the RIGHT collarbone, red dragon over the upper abdomen, koi on the LEFT flank, 'kickboxing' script low on the abdomen, right-arm sleeve, left-hand and left-forearm work, portrait on the RIGHT thigh. All sides are his own (viewer's opposite when he faces the camera). macro/ageOldM 0.215 follows avatar3d.js (39-25)/65; heightUpM 0.32 is interpolated from the other 188-196 cm sheets, so scale the mesh to 193 cm if supported.
